info.background_text:
A shaman maiden who sealed the eternal darkness.
The successor of the Getsuei-ken (Shadow of the Moon Sword), and a shaman maiden hailing from the planet, Umishiro. She conducts herself with refined grace and dignity, and possesses an unbendable will. Perpetually orbited by the Dark, she has never known defeat, as all things crumble and fall before her.
